title: What they said at the time

clips.q: We would like to thank all of our loyal customers of the past 27 years and with a tear in our eye, say ¡Adios!
It took Mexican food and really put in full-service quality with fast-food pricing.
clips.who: **Jack Butorac**, former Chi-Chi’s vice president, The Courier-Journal, Nov 30, 2003[^15]

clips.q: In two years they lost 55 percent of their sales doing menu changes. It was a huge strategic error.
clips.who: **Jack Butorac**, on Foodmaker’s management, The Courier-Journal, Nov 30, 2003. His figure; we could not check it[^15]

clips.q: The question we have to ask ourselves now is do we have enough time and resources to see this company through its darkest hour.
clips.who: **William G. Knuff III**, Prandium director, Orange County Business Journal, Nov 9, 2003[^17]

clips.q: I won’t go to Chi-Chi’s again.
clips.who: **Barbara Barrickman**, shopper at the Beaver Valley Mall, Associated Press, Nov 15, 2003[^14]

clips.q: However, the outbreak at Restaurant A was unusually large.
clips.who: **Centers for Disease Control and Prevention**, MMWR, Nov 2003[^12]

clips.q: It’s going to be a tough sell.
clips.who: **Ron Paul**, president of Technomic, The Courier-Journal, Nov 30, 2003[^15]

clips.q: We felt it was a good opportunity to acquire a large number of good locations that we can use for our brands.
clips.who: **Joseph Kadow**, Outback Steakhouse, Associated Press, Sep 2004[^20]

clips.q: I think Chi-Chi’s and their insurance companies have done a remarkable job at getting this done.
clips.who: **William Marler**, plaintiffs’ lawyer, Pittsburgh Tribune-Review, Dec 21, 2005[^23]
**Tracy Polovina**, who ate at the restaurant and received a shot, Pittsburgh Tribune-Review, Dec 21, 2005[^23]

clips.q: I still have fond memories of growing up in the Chi-Chi’s restaurants that my father built throughout their time, instilling in me the passion and determination to pursue my own career in the restaurant industry.
clips.who: **Michael McDermott**, statement quoted by Nation’s Restaurant News, Dec 4, 2024[^30]
